entries.fdcb868d6697b521: Since its founding, the company has pursued 'value-added appeal mail order' targeting middle-aged and older men, and says it aims to become Japan's leading creator of wants through 'Wants products' based on basic concepts such as 'novelty,' 'dreams' and 'fun.' In product strategy, it says it will focus on strengthening the development and branding of Wants products; in customer strategy, it will focus on expanding its middle-aged and older male customer base, as well as expanding new customers with the women's market in view. It lists as challenges: in the Real Estate Business, increasing rental income and considering the sale of real estate held for sale; and in the day-care business, increasing the number of users and improving operating efficiency.
